We are looking for a senior, hands-on network specialist operating complex Cisco-based environments. You will work with business-critical core, WAN and data center networks where availability, stability and operational quality are essential. Today, our environment is primarily based on traditional network operations. At the same time, we are evolving toward more standardized and automated network services, giving you the opportunity to combine deep networking expertise with modern ways of operating infrastructure.
